description: This file contains extension methods for configuring ADO.NET persistent streaming in an Orleans silo, allowing users to add and configure ADO.NET streams via the ISiloBuilder interface.

classes.name: SiloBuilderAdoNetStreamExtensions
classes.description: Provides static extension methods to configure ADO.NET streams in Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: AddAdoNetStreams
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo to use ADO.NET persistent streams with specified options.

methods.name: AddAdoNetStreams
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo to use ADO.NET persistent streams with a specified configurator delegate.
